claims.head: A shadow job for O'Connor, Pettersson (#40) and Karlsson
claims.call: The Canucks’ L2 (O'Connor, Pettersson (#40) and Karlsson) spends at least 71% of its 5-on-5 time against the Wild’s first line.
claims.body: At home, the Canucks keep sending Pettersson (#40)’s line (O'Connor, Pettersson (#40) and Karlsson) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Manny Malhotra has been giving this group the hard job of facing the other team’s top line. Tonight the Wild’s first line is Kaprizov, Ek and Boldy.

claims.gist: At home, Manny Malhotra likes to pick matchups, so watch who goes out against the Wild’s first line.

notes.text: Marcus Foligno is on injured reserve and has missed the last 7 games. He is one of their more valuable skaters.
Maxim Shabanov is day to day (upper-body injury) and missed their last game. He is a top-six forward.
Brock Faber is on injured reserve (skull surgery) and has not played this season. He is a top-pair defenseman. Jonas Brodin has taken his spot beside Quinn Hughes.
Tyler Pitlick was added to the roster on Oct 13 and has played beside Michael McCarron and Rieger Lorenz.

The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 10 games cover only 31% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the 8th-lowest in the league (a typical team: 43%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Marco Rossi returned in their last game after missing 2 games.
Max Sasson has started killing penalties: on the ice for 35% of the team’s shorthanded time in 12 games, up from 4% last season.

VAN.head: The Canucks have their work cut out
VAN.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage, Minnesota has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. The Canucks’ best hope is getting good looks, plus a big night in goal.

MIN.head: The Wild should be in control
MIN.body: Even though Vancouver has home-ice advantage, Minnesota has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately. If the Canucks want to spoil it, start with getting good looks.
